name: glassnode_help
description: Extended documentation for all glassnode_* tools: API-wide usage guidance, pricing notes, and workflows published by the vendor (llms.txt). Takes no arguments and returns the full document. Call this before other glassnode_* tools when unsure how to use them.

name: glassnode_metadata_assets
description: List all assets and their metadata ($0.01 USDC on Base per call): Glassnode id, symbol, name, asset_type (BLOCKCHAIN/TOKEN), blockchains with contract addresses and decimals, external ids (CoinMarketCap, Coingecko, CCData) and semantic tags. The optional CEL filter narrows the list, e.g. filter=asset.id=='USDT', filter=asset.blockchains.exists(b,b.blockchain=='ETH') or filter=asset.semantic_tags.exists(tag,tag=='stablecoin').

filter.description: CEL (Common Expression Language) filter over asset fields, e.g. asset.id=='BTC'.

name: glassnode_metadata_metric
description: Metadata for a single Glassnode metric ($0.01 USDC on Base per call): the metric's allowed parameters and their values, defaults applied when parameters are omitted, the available timerange, descriptors (name, group, description, tags) and docs/studio links. path is required (e.g. /distribution/balance_exchanges); passing additional parameters (a, e, i, ...) narrows the returned parameter values to that drill-down.

path.description: Metric path without the /v1/metrics prefix, e.g. /addresses/count or /distribution/balance_exchanges.

a.description: Narrow the parameter drill-down to one asset, e.g. BTC.

c.description: Narrow by currency, e.g. native, usd.

name: glassnode_metadata_metrics
description: List all available Glassnode metric paths ($0.01 USDC on Base per call), returned without the /v1/metrics prefix (e.g. /addresses/count). Feed a path to glassnode_metadata_metric for its allowed parameters and to glassnode_metrics_category_metric for the data. Optional filters narrow the list: a (asset, repeatable: a=BTC&a=ETH), c currency, e exchange, f format, i interval, from_exchange, to_exchange, miner, maturity, network, period, quote_symbol.

a.description: Filter by asset id, e.g. BTC (repeatable).

c.description: Filter by currency for values, e.g. native, usd.

e.description: Filter by exchange name, e.g. binance, coinbase.

f.description: Filter by response format, e.g. json, csv.

from_exchange.description: Filter by source exchange for inter-exchange metrics.

to_exchange.description: Filter by destination exchange for inter-exchange metrics.

miner.description: Filter by miner identifier for mining-related metrics.

maturity.description: Filter by maturity period for derivatives metrics.

network.description: Filter by network/blockchain identifier for cross-chain metrics.

quote_symbol.description: Filter by quote currency symbol for trading pairs.

name: glassnode_metrics_category_metric
description: Fetch any Glassnode metric time series ($0.05 USDC on Base per call). The x402 gateway mirrors api.glassnode.com metric paths one-to-one. Discover metric paths with glassnode_metadata_metrics (returned without the /v1/metrics prefix, e.g. /distribution/balance_exchanges), then pass category = the first path segment and metric = the second segment (two-segment paths; deeper sub-path variants are not addressable here). a (asset, e.g. BTC) is required. Check a metric's exact allowed parameters, intervals and defaults with glassnode_metadata_metric before paying.

category.description: First segment of the metric path, e.g. 'market' for /market/price_usd_close or 'distribution' for /distribution/balance_exchanges.

metric.description: Second segment of the metric path, e.g. 'price_usd_close' or 'balance_exchanges'.

a.description: Asset symbol, e.g. BTC, ETH, USDT (supported assets via glassnode_metadata_assets).

i.description: Frequency interval — metric-dependent subset of 10m, 1h, 24h, 1w, 1month (metadata_metric lists the allowed values).

s.description: Start of the time window as a unix timestamp (seconds).

u.description: End of the time window as a unix timestamp (seconds).

c.description: Currency for values where supported, e.g. native or USD (metric-dependent).

e.description: Exchange filter for exchange-scoped metrics, e.g. binance, coinbase, aggregated (metric-dependent).

network.description: Network filter for network-scoped metrics, e.g. aggregated, arb, base, eth, opt (metric-dependent).

from_exchange.description: Source exchange for inter-exchange flow metrics (metric-dependent).

to_exchange.description: Destination exchange for inter-exchange flow metrics (metric-dependent).

quote_symbol.description: Quote currency symbol for trading-pair metrics (metric-dependent).
